english.title: Fishing vessel owner fail to ensure fisherman receives medical treatment / taken ashore
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), failed to ensure that a fisherman, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), who suffered sickness or injury during the term of the fisherman's work agreement

(A)_[received medical treatment on board the vessel so far as was practical]_
(B)_[received medical treatment ashore]_
(C)_[was taken ashore in a timely manner]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(2), (4) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 30 provides a defence for the person charged to show that all reasonable steps had been taken by that person to ensure compliance with the provision concerned.
(ii) Regulation 28A(1) provides that the fishing vessel can be detained where a fishing vessel does not comply with these Regulations; and the conditions on board are hazardous to the safety, health or security of fishermen; or a serious breach or the latest in a series of repeated breaches of these Regulations or the requirements of the Work in Fishing Convention,
